help_modal.build_warship_desc: Patrols in an area, capturing enemy trade ships and destroying their Boats (transport ships) and Warships. Spawns from the nearest Port and patrols the area you first clicked to build it. You can control Warships by attack-clicking on them (see action Attack under Hotkeys) and then attack-clicking the new area you want them to move to.
help_modal.openback_fuel_train: Fuel Train — A completed Military Base automatically links to a completed Runway within rail range. Camouflaged fuel convoys travel on visible rails between them and earn half the normal city/factory train income.
help_modal.openback_manpad: MANPAD — A defensive interceptor that automatically destroys an enemy plane entering its range. The MANPAD is consumed when it intercepts a plane.
help_modal.openback_military_base: Military Base — Builds and stores tanks. Additional base levels increase a tank's maximum driving range.
help_modal.openback_plane: Plane — Load troops onto a completed Runway, then select enemy land in range. Everyone sees its route and landing zone. A successful crash captures a beachhead that must be fought normally; MANPAD interception destroys the plane and its troops.
help_modal.openback_runway: Runway — Builds, loads, and stores one plane. Stack/upgrade Runways to extend the plane's maximum flight range.
help_modal.openback_tank: Tank — Build it at a Military Base, then select enemy land connected by a land route. It drives 50% faster than a transport ship, sweeps radioactive fallout on both sides, triggers Tank Mines, and explodes at its destination.
help_modal.openback_tank_mine: Tank Mine — A defensive structure that automatically destroys an enemy tank entering its range and loses one level when triggered.
help_modal.openback_units_intro: OpenBack adds an airborne invasion system and a land-assault system. Build the supporting structure first, load its vehicle, then select a valid enemy destination.
help_modal.openback_visibility: Visibility — Plane routes and landing zones are public. Tank routes and targets are visible only to the owner and allies; enemies see the tank and the radioactive trail it leaves behind.
